_readme: Mode profile for DUET mode: a pre-rendered exchange between Host (cj-beta) and Panganiban (cj-alpha). No microphone is open anywhere: the console forces the floor to `none` and rejects any floor request while this mode is active. Values here are the base of the resolution order: mode profile -> systemd drop-in -> app/.env -> console override. Keep secrets out of this file.
host_intro_text: Good day. Please enjoy a short exchange between Chief Justice Panganiban and myself.

event._note: Same as kiosk; the speech settings are inert in duet because no mic opens, but they are kept so switching to direct carries the event thresholds.
